subject: Literature
title: Henry Miller's Tropic of Cancer
description: One-minute skill: Henry Miller's Tropic of Cancer.

hook.text: Tropic of Cancer was published in Paris in 1934 but banned in the United States for twenty-seven years.

buildup.text: Miller's autobiographical novel depicted bohemian life in Paris with graphic sexual honesty unprecedented in literature.

discovery.text: Travelers who smuggled copies into America had their books confiscated by customs agents at the border.

twist.text: When finally published in America in 1961, it triggered over sixty separate obscenity trials across the country.

climax.text: The Supreme Court's 1964 ruling clearing the novel helped establish that explicit content alone cannot define obscenity.

punchline.text: Sixty trials later, America decided honesty is not a crime.

quiz.question: How long was Tropic of Cancer banned in the United States?
